column3: Keywords: quantum optics, entanglement, quantum sensing.
Theory of quantum light pulses propagating through networks of quantum components (PhD).
Fusion-based quantum computation and theoretical quantum optics (PhD).
Quantum photonics: deterministic light-matter interfaces with quantum emitters in photonic nanostructures; directs the Hy-Q Center for Hybrid Quantum Networks.

Quantum physics of matter and light: quantum communication, sensing and information technology, including teleportation between material objects and measurements beyond standard quantum limits; leads QUANTOP.
Theoretical quantum optics, implementation of quantum information processing, and ultracold atoms.
Optical quantum magnetic-field sensors for better MRI resolution; founder of Magnolia Quantum Sensing.
